note: The 26 hops, one table in code. Each holds its FINISHED word, from step 2 on, so the top line can't read yes early: a row's word comes from what a click recorded in run-receipt.json, and top_line.mjs compares the two. adapter is 'stand-in' for real code with a named stand-in inside it and 'written' for code written for this simulation; the count keeps them apart. when is where the finished hop runs: recorded once, built when the page starts, or on each click. recorded_inputs are the kinds of file the hop may read without this click having written it, each vouched for by the receipt that wrote it. stand_ins are the finished stand-ins, named; a row's stand-in missing from this list keeps the top line at not yet.
